command: podman run --rm -v "$MISSION":/mission:ro -v "$OUT":/out "$IMAGE" bash -c 'taskset -c 0-3 python3 lvio_exp/run_comfort.py /mission/comfort_offline /out/config.yaml /out --name snow-3 --imu-dt -0.0048' > "$OUT/run.log" 2>&1 && python3 systems/se3-lvio/tools/to_prism.py "$MISSION/comfort_offline/calib.json" "$OUT/snow-3_imu.tum" "$OUT/estimate.tum"

env.IMAGE: the system's container image (systems/systems.yaml; local tag in lvx.local.yaml)
env.PATH: the caller's PATH, after the machine's own tool folders (lvx.local.yaml `path`, e.g. a docker shim)
